display.purpose: Home hero headline only; 2.25rem rising to 3.75rem.

headline.purpose: Page title in every app page header; 1.5rem rising to 1.75rem.

title.purpose: Product names on tiles, two-line clamp.

body.purpose: Working size across account and admin; 16px on phone inputs.

label.purpose: Badges, table headers, captions; sentence case.

price.purpose: Every money value and count; tabular figures, 16/20/30px by size.

shadows.name: surface-ring
shadows.purpose: Resting edge of every surface card; depth by tone, not outline.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on interactive cards and the floating unsaved-changes bar.

shadows.name: raised-dark
shadows.purpose: Raised shadow in the dark theme.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5)
shadows.purpose: Sticky headers and the phone bottom navigation bar.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible on buttons and inputs; links use a 2px ring with 2px offset.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: House curve for reveals, field errors, list entries and meters (200-300ms UI, 500-700ms meters).

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Scale 0.92 to 1 for confirmation glyphs (copied checks).

motion.name: pulse-glow
motion.purpose: Current step of the repair progress track only.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Skeleton blocks; navigation skeletons fade in over 100ms and are skipped for prefetched visits landing within 120ms.

motion.name: cta-bar
motion.value: translateY(100%) to 0, 200ms ease-out in, 150ms ease-in out

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration and transition-duration 0.01ms, one iteration, scroll-behavior auto

narrative.overview:
TechLandier looks like a good local electronics shop with the lights on: cool neutral surfaces, product art in the middle of the frame, and one blue accent that marks what you can act on. The store is calm so the devices and the prices can be loud. Nothing is decorative for its own sake; tint, weight and the occasional raised shadow carry hierarchy, and state colours appear only when something actually has a state.

Money is the subject the system treats most carefully. Prices use tabular figures in the body face, installment amounts sit next to the full price with the fee named, and every order that is being paid over time says so in one shared phrase. Density is moderate on the storefront (photo-led grids, generous gaps) and compact in the account and admin shells (tables, stat tiles, badges), but both share the same tokens, radii and type.

The system is phone first. Touch layouts get 44px targets through a `pointer: coarse` variant rather than a separate mobile skin, purchase and save actions stay pinned within thumb reach, and every navigation answers on the tap with the skeleton of the page it is heading to.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral tonal layering (page, card, popover) with a single blue accent (hue 262).
Geist for everything, Inter as the named second face in the stack; no serif, no monospace for numbers.
Pill-shaped controls, softly rounded cards (18px), surfaces separated by tone and a hairline ring, not heavy borders.
Status always as tinted pill plus dot plus words; colour is never the only signal.
Light and dark themes are both first-class, switched by a `.dark` class applied before first paint.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that means "act here" or "you are here". Green, amber and red are reserved for state and never used as decoration or as a second brand colour.

rules.name: The Tinted Pill Rule
rules.body: A state colour at full strength appears on text, dots and thin meters; its area fills are always a 10 to 14% tint.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count and installment figure uses `font-feature-settings: "tnum"` in the body face. Never a monospace font for money.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: In the app, labels and captions are sentence case at 12px/500. Uppercase tracked lettering is not part of the app's type ramp.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: On phones the primary action for the screen (Buy, Pay, Save) is pinned to the bottom edge, and toasts move to the top so they never cover it.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when an element floats above the page or responds to hover.

dos: **Do** keep the accent singular: Counter Blue (`oklch(0.5 0.2 262)`, dark `oklch(0.7 0.16 262)`) for actions, links, focus and current place.
**Do** give every touch target 44px under `pointer: coarse`, including compact and icon buttons and table-card links.
**Do** render every status through the status badge: tinted pill, dot and words.
**Do** describe an installment order as "On plan · N of M paid" everywhere it appears, and state the per-installment amount, cadence and fee next to any price that offers a plan.
**Do** use tabular figures for all money and counts.
**Do** separate cards from the page by tone and a hairline ring; save the Raised shadow for floating and hovered elements.
**Do** show the destination's skeleton the moment a navigation starts, and keep phone CTAs pinned above the safe-area inset.
**Do** honour reduced motion globally and keep transitions on Ease Out Soft.
**Do** keep emails and PDFs on the same neutral-plus-blue palette as the app.
donts: **Don't** use green, amber or red as decoration or as a secondary brand colour.
**Don't** convey status by colour alone; the label always renders.
**Don't** show a plan order as a bare "Paid" while installments are outstanding, or a cancelled unpaid order as "Unpaid".
**Don't** use native date or select inputs.
**Don't** set money in a monospace face.
**Don't** fill a pill or panel with a state colour at full strength.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings, in the app or in email.
